name: Menou-kun no Oshiete Onee-chan-sensei
original_name: 瑪瑙くんのおしえてお姉ちゃん先生
source:
Main character is given summer vacations task to touch nature and describe experience in the notebook. But he lives in the city! So he comes to his relative's house and is greeted by pretty little girls. They happily agree to play in the nature together, but they are eager to learn a lot from this new onii-chan.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公暑假的作业是亲近自然，并把经历记录在笔记本上。
可他住在城市！
于是他来到亲戚家，几名可爱的小女孩迎接了他。
她们高兴地答应一起到自然中玩耍，又迫不及待想向这位新来的哥哥学到许多东西。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
